finding.trigger: The bound source changes while a V2 close task is draining an already canceled action/render.
sequence: requestOriginalV2Close captures the actual action/render, calls cancelOriginalOperations to cancel and clear their shared handles, then keeps originalExitInProgress true while originalExitTask drains those captured tasks.

The source onChange cancels originalExitTask and calls resetOriginalV2Source. Reset captures the now-empty shared action/render handles and does not await the exit task that still owns the real drain.
The replacement task can call loadUI before the canceled exit task finishes. loadUI returns because originalExitInProgress is still true.
The old exit defer eventually clears originalExitInProgress, but no code restarts loading. The replacement source remains on an empty loading form.
finding.requiredRepair: Capture and drain the old exit owner as well as action/render work before replacement-source loading, with explicit generation ownership and restored exit flags. Do not clear handles to bypass actual pending work.

otherInspectedFacts: V2 route only consumes exact LOGIN_UI_V2 admission.
Legacy OK and dismissal autosave are excluded once the V2 route is selected.
Candidate render projection occurs off main and rebases current input without running source JS twice.
Explicit checked login result precedes close; source-render failure retains prior form/state/session.
